reference.scope: Metric deltas cover all four official rounds, including discarded warmup. Server concurrency/cache peaks are sampled, not exact maxima. Admission counters are cumulative from service start and logged at most once/minute.

candidate.scope: Metric deltas cover all four official rounds, including discarded warmup. Server concurrency/cache peaks are sampled, not exact maxima. Admission counters are cumulative from service start and logged at most once/minute.

limitations: Historical service sessions, not interleaved A/B. Lower preemption alone does not establish an optimization; assess throughput and latency together.
scheduler_policy: original; admission telemetry must be absent
